name: frontend-contract-complete
body: For every language apg ships a frontend for, the spec must name the frontend's build-time dependencies, scan-time dependencies, and engine pin, and the frontend code named by the contract must resolve in the branch graph; the bundled structural scanner must name its build-time dependencies, its scan-time dependencies, and that it imposes no language-version ceiling. A frontend declared without any of these, or a code reference that does not resolve, is a violation.
